receipt.boundary: Resident original RGBA8 to complete independent VP8 WebP bytes with exact normalized alpha. Full source normalization and repacking included. Native codec/scratch/frame/packet wrappers reused; RGBA-to-BGRA repacking and complete encode execute every operation. Alpha-weighted RGB source-error matching before composite rounding, <=0.25 dB fixed band; unweighted decoder agreement includes hidden RGB.
